links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT versus Google answers (FKGL, SMOG, FRES) for patient comprehension
links.effect: Google had a higher FRES score, so its content was simpler. ChatGPT's academic language may be hard for some patient groups. Numeric FKGL, SMOG and FRES values are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: However, the academic language used by ChatGPT may be challenging for some patient groups, whereas Google's superficial information is a significant limitation.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark comparing ChatGPT-4 and Google search results on FAQs regarding unicondylar knee arthroplasty for accuracy and readability.
